ClientResponses.Response:
Thanks for giving us the opportunity to help you get your grill working! You should be able to easily reach cooking and searing temperature (500°F). If your grill is not getting that hot, there is a reason why! Our Support team sent you an email follow-up to help troubleshoot and get your grill working properly. 

It is possible that the issue is being caused by a safety mechanism in the grill. Once you have performed a leak test to rule out a leak, these steps can help:


1) Make sure the lid of your grill is open and all the control knobs on the grill are in the OFF position (including the side burner knob, if you have one).

2) Turn on your gas supply by opening the valve on top of the tank.

3) Wait for 60 seconds for pressure to build up in the hose before doing anything. The pressure is going to push the device into place to give it the “all clear” for normal operation. Waiting for the pressure to build up is the most important part of this process.

4) After you’ve waited, go ahead and light your grill as you normally would by turning the appropriate burner one at a time to start/high and hitting the igniter button. 

5) Light all the main burners and set them to high, then close the lid. Give your grill about 10 to 15 minutes and it should be in the 500 to 550 F range, which means your grill is now working properly.
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

We are thrilled to hear that you like your grill! However, we'd like to apologize for the inconvenience caused by the missing parts. Our Support team reached out to you via email to help with your warming rack. Sometimes we receive questions about this warming rack due to a common misunderstanding during assembly. 
Please confirm that you are attempting to install the warming into the BACK two slots in the cookbox, not the front two. Attempting to install the warming rack in the front two slots will give the impression that the rack is not big enough for the grill. We apologize for any confusion!
Thanks again for taking the time to provide your feedback. Happy grilling!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

45010001.Description:
Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.


 This product requires assembly.
